payout_quote: As a referrer you will receive $200 for each referral, subject to program conditions. Referrers are limited to 15 referrals per year and 30 referrals total.
steps: Be an eligible IBKR client: individual or joint account with net liquidation value of at least $2,000 and at least one securities trade placed
Generate your unique referral link in IBKR Client Portal (Settings > Account Configuration > Refer a Friend)
Share the link; your friend must open an individual or joint account through the link and deposit at least $10,000 within 30 days
Friend must maintain at least a $10,000 balance for one year; you receive the $200 flat fee payment per eligible referral
catches: Friend must deposit at least $10,000 within 30 days of opening AND maintain that balance for a full year — payout only after the year completes
Referrer must already be an IBKR client with $2,000+ account value and at least one securities trade
Cap: 15 referrals per calendar year, 30 total per referrer
Residents of Japan, Denmark, Spain, Portugal, Poland, mainland China and Israel are ineligible; financial advisors, hedge funds, institutional accounts ineligible
One payment per referred client even if they open multiple accounts; family/household referrals excluded per detailed terms
Referrer may not act as broker/dealer or assist with the referred client's account beyond the initial referral
biggest_catch: Your friend must deposit at least $10,000 within 30 days and keep it invested for a full year before you see the $200.
eligibility: Existing IBKR clients with individual/joint accounts, $2,000+ net liquidation value, and at least one securities trade; not residents of the excluded countries
timing: $200 flat fee paid after the referred client's one-year balance-maintenance period completes
